authority.rule: Edit the canonical JSON, validate it, and regenerate the status document; do not hand-edit generated status text.

analysis_population.constraint: Day-28 tissue claims describe the imaged survivors. They do not describe all infected animals or estimate survival.

reasons: There is one day-28 imaged survivor in each genotype-by-condition cell; this is not an enrollment count.
The full interaction model has no residual degrees of freedom.
Selected imaging fields are nested observations and are not independent biological replicates.

permitted: Describe thresholded KRT5 burden in the selected confocal fields for each imaged mouse.
Report field-level and mouse-level descriptive summaries with the sampling and denominator limitations attached.
Describe H&E and WSI work as engineering or image-QC development only.
prohibited: Do not make genotype, condition, interaction, or population-level inferential claims.
Do not represent selected fields as whole-lung prevalence or unbiased whole-section sampling.
Do not claim a validated KRT5-positive and PDPN-positive dysplastic-alveolar endpoint.
Do not claim cross-panel same-cell colocalization.
Do not make immune-lineage or validated lesion claims from H&E or the WSI pilot.

modalities.label: Confocal selected fields
modalities.scope: Descriptive thresholded KRT5 measurements in selected fields only.

field_exceptions.constraint: The whole-field denominator is scientifically non-comparable with the normal auto-DAPI tissue denominators until a comparable tissue ROI is produced and validated.
Retain the partial-field flag in every field-level and aggregated derivative.

modalities.promotion_gate: Replace or validate the whole-field tissue denominator with a tissue ROI that is comparable to the frozen auto-DAPI denominator, then rebuild and reconcile every derivative.

modalities.label: H&E histology
modalities.scope: H0-H3 engineering and image-QC artifacts plus H4 review and H7-H8 aggregation mechanics; H4 and later biological outputs remain unvalidated and blocked from scientific interpretation.
modalities.promotion_gate: Complete the blinded H4 review and independently validate anatomy, lesion-candidate, topology, and section-to-mouse interpretation before any lesion claim.

modalities.label: WSI threshold pilot
modalities.scope: Legacy six-tile evidence plus prospective real-source engineering smokes; not a calibrated global biological endpoint.
modalities.promotion_gate: Review tissue and airway masks, freeze modality-specific calibration, complete an uncapped declared-section run, and validate the endpoint across an adequate mouse-level sample.

project_gates.acceptance: Versioned route adapters, provenance-bound aggregation, and rejection fixtures cover unevaluable, duplicate, channel-mismatched, hash-drifted, incomplete, failed, and rejected records.
M4-2 LEFT F06 has a reviewed tissue ROI comparable to the frozen auto-DAPI reference space, and all 80 field and aggregate rows reconcile exactly.
Future prevalence claims use exhaustive or probability-based sampling and prospectively justified biological replication; the present release remains descriptive regardless of engineering completion.
Complete blinded H4 scoring and independent expert validation of anatomy, lesion candidates, topology, and mouse-level interpretation before H&E is promoted beyond engineering and QC.
Expert-review tissue and airway reference masks, freeze calibration, run an uncapped declared section, and validate the WSI endpoint across an adequate mouse-level sample.

Replay the sealed StarDist runtime and explicit model on a supported deployment fixture, then complete a blinded expert benchmark and freeze model and threshold acceptance criteria before scientific use.
